meta.name: agency-docs-updater
meta.description: End-to-end pipeline for publishing Claude Code lab meetings. Automatically finds/creates Fathom transcript, downloads video, uploads to YouTube, generates fact-checked Russian summary, creates MDX documentation, and pushes to agency-docs for Vercel deployment. Single invocation replaces 5+ manual steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
